classification: STATIC Windows PowerShell 5.1 execution of the shared Island rules
tests: ✔ V47-V49: every edge, work area, size and offset places the notch fully inside the WorkArea
✔ V47: top and bottom are horizontal with agent indicators LEFT of the body
✔ V48: left and right are vertical with agent indicators at the TOP of the body
✔ V49: indicator layout is bounded (at most 3 chips plus one overflow chip) and counts overflow exactly
✔ V47/V48: the indicator axis follows the notch orientation (a column beside a horizontal notch, a row above a vertical one)
✔ V49: the DPI-scaled 1536x816 work area (125%) keeps the default top notch centred and on-screen
✔ V49: the bottom notch sits above the taskbar edge with the same margin as the top
✔ Visual layer routes every edge through Get-BunnyPlacement and keeps the window title unchanged
✔ V47/V48: the vertical size is swapped before placement (length along the edge, thickness across it)
✔ display-settings and DPI changes re-fit the notch through Resize-Bunny (size clamp and placement), not only the position
✔ the indicator rule is shared: Visual asks Get-BunnyIndicatorLayout for the side and axis, never a second rule
✔ no random value anywhere in the Island layer (placement, indicators and layout are deterministic)
✔ T11 chips: team members are lettered by role and their tooltip names role, state and their own task
✔ T11 chips: the notch draws chips from the shared facts, never a second lettering rule
✔ T2: discovery hash cache invalidates a file replacement and the final check rejects it
✔ T7 P29 directory replacement after registration requires relink
✔ T9R Host replacement: mission and Agent commands pinned to another Host or epoch change nothing
✔ T9R readiness refuses Wrong signed application without replacement or invocation
✔ T9R readiness refuses Frame PID lifetime changed without replacement or invocation
✔ T9R readiness refuses Content PID lifetime changed without replacement or invocation
✔ T9R readiness refuses HWND replacement without replacement or invocation
✔ T9R readiness refuses Stale UIA element without replacement or invocation
✔ T9R readiness refuses Readiness budget exhausted without replacement or invocation
✔ T9R readiness refuses Modal or password control without replacement or invocation
✔ stale closed native target produces one controlled replacement
✔ target disappearance after batch admission cannot cause a replacement launch
✔ V47 agent indicators left of horizontal notch: UI intent is one-shot and names the agent to open
✔ V47b uiIntent kinds: open_agentic and open_agent focus the Agentic sheet, open_approvals opens it without a focus
✔ V48 agent indicators top of vertical notch: a stale uiIntent after reload does not navigate
✔ V49 notch within usable bounds: the status copy is short enough for the notch and carries no newlines
